description: This file defines the ReactAgentController class, which manages the state and interactions for a Flutter UI related to a React Agent feature. It handles user inputs, updates steps, controls the agent's lifecycle, and provides UI-related helper methods for rendering step icons, colors, and titles.

classes.name: ReactAgentController
classes.description: Controller for managing the state and interactions of the React Agent UI screen, including user input, agent steps, and activity status.

methods.name: startAgent
methods.description: Initiates the agent process if the user input is valid; shows error message if input is empty.

methods.name: clearSteps
methods.description: Resets the agent state, steps, and user input.

methods.name: setUserInput
methods.description: Updates the user input string and notifies listeners.

methods.name: getStepIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon associated with a specific StepType.

methods.name: getStepColor
methods.description: Returns the color associated with a specific StepType.

methods.name: getStepTitle
methods.description: Returns the string title associated with a specific StepType.
